fact: La Gazette des Comores reports the AMECC project coordinator saying the current civil registration system is still largely manual, with frequent errors, falsification and lost documents, ahead of a planned digitisation study launched 10 October 2025.

La Gazette des Comores reports that AMECC aims to modernise a civil registration system still largely dependent on old paper registers, with people in rural areas still holding no birth extract in 2026.

Comores Droit states that for decades births, marriages and deaths in Comoros have been recorded in paper registers, with only one in five of 37 surveyed civil-status centres having internet access (preliminary study, March 2026).
